I replied to Dana in the #north-team thread: the ticket is **IT #4092**, to replace the hub in Zoom Room B.

- **Where it came from:** Ilse mentioned it in #north-random, which Dana is a member of. In the same message she warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, or the Polycom resets. I passed that tip on too.
- **Ticket status:** #help-it-ops has no messages, so I couldn't see whether the ticket is still open. I told Dana that.
